findings.message: Binding "version" pins a version number; Camunda 8 binds by latest, deployment or version tag.
findings.suggestion: Tag the target with a version tag and use bindingType="versionTag", or use "deployment".

findings.message: Variable passing kept as in Camunda 7: no parent variables in, no child variables out.
Execution platform set to Camunda Cloud 8.10.0 (was Camunda Platform).
findings.suggestion: Camunda Modeler opens the file as a Camunda 8 diagram.
